question.text:
How many of these molecules can have any type of hydrogen bonding.
Glucose, HF, R-OH,R-COOH,R2NH,CCl3CHO,Ph-Br , o-nitro phenol, PH3 .

solution.text: Glucose, HF, <math><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi><mo>-</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">R</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">N</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></math> have intermolecular H-bonding while <math><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></math> and o-nitro phenol has intramolecular H-bonding.
